claim: Features: board visibility, workspace members, Trello imports, labels and filters, comments, activity log, templates, integrations coming soon
Made with Next.js, tRPC, Better Auth, Tailwind CSS, Drizzle ORM, React Email
Self-hosting: Railway template, Docker Compose with migrate service, web on port 3000, postgres:15
Environment variables for SMTP, OIDC and S3 storage
